name: price
meaning: day-ahead price, EUR/MWh; the target

name: has_price
meaning: price exists and is valid: the loss mask

name: price_filled
meaning: the lag inputs of this hour came from a short gap fill

name: hour_local
meaning: Brussels local hour 0-23

name: dow
meaning: day of week, 0 = Monday

name: month
meaning: month 1-12

name: hour_sin
meaning: sin(2 pi hour/24)

name: hour_cos
meaning: cos(2 pi hour/24)

name: dow_sin
meaning: sin(2 pi dow/7)

name: dow_cos
meaning: cos(2 pi dow/7)

name: month_sin
meaning: sin(2 pi (month-1)/12)

name: month_cos
meaning: cos(2 pi (month-1)/12)

name: is_weekend
meaning: Saturday or Sunday

name: price_lag24
meaning: price of the same hour on D-1 (D-1 prices are published on D-2)

name: price_lag168
meaning: price of the same hour one week earlier; the persistence forecast

name: price_wk_change
meaning: price_lag24 - price_lag168

name: price_d1_mean
meaning: mean of the zone's D-1 prices (mean of price_lag24 over D)

name: price_d1_min
meaning: min of the zone's D-1 prices

name: price_d1_max
meaning: max of the zone's D-1 prices

name: price_d1_std
meaning: std of the zone's D-1 prices (intra-day shape / volatility)

name: europe_price_lag24
meaning: mean price_lag24 over all priced zones that hour

name: price_lag24_vs_europe
meaning: price_lag24 - europe_price_lag24

name: nb_price_lag24
meaning: mean price_lag24 over interconnected neighbours (non-graph baselines)

name: load_fc
meaning: ENTSO-E day-ahead load forecast, MW (vintage caveat in the dataset doc)

name: load_fc_lag168
meaning: load forecast of the same hour one week earlier

name: load_fc_wk_change
meaning: load_fc / load_fc_lag168 - 1

name: load_fc_ramp
meaning: load_fc minus the previous hour's load_fc

name: load_fc_day_rel
meaning: load_fc / mean load_fc of delivery day D (daily shape)

name: temp_pw
meaning: population-weighted temperature, same hour (perfect-forecast ablation only)

name: temp_anom
meaning: temperature anomaly vs climatology, same hour (ablation only)

name: wind_cf
meaning: wind capacity factor, same hour (ablation only)

name: low_wind
meaning: low-wind flag, same hour (ablation only)

name: solar_cf
meaning: solar capacity factor, same hour (ablation only)

name: temp_pw_lag24
meaning: temperature same hour D-1; NOT a legal day-D input: hours after 10:00 UTC are D-1 after the cutoff (use temp_pw_asof)

name: temp_anom_lag24
meaning: temperature anomaly same hour D-1; not a legal day-D input (use temp_anom_asof)

name: wind_cf_lag24
meaning: wind capacity factor same hour D-1; not a legal day-D input (use wind_cf_asof)

name: solar_cf_lag24
meaning: solar capacity factor same hour D-1; not a legal day-D input (use solar_cf_asof)

name: temp_pw_lag48
meaning: temperature same hour D-2: strictly observed at gate closure

name: temp_anom_lag48
meaning: temperature anomaly same hour D-2

name: wind_cf_lag48
meaning: wind capacity factor same hour D-2

name: solar_cf_lag48
meaning: solar capacity factor same hour D-2

name: temp_pw_asof
meaning: temperature of the same clock hour, latest observed at the cutoff: lag 24 up to 10:00 UTC, lag 48 after

name: temp_anom_asof
meaning: temperature anomaly, as temp_pw_asof

name: wind_cf_asof
meaning: wind capacity factor, as temp_pw_asof

name: solar_cf_asof
meaning: solar capacity factor, as temp_pw_asof

name: heat_stress
meaning: max(temp_anom_asof, 0): positive anomaly only (H3)

name: net_import
meaning: physical imports - exports with modelled zones, MW (outcome for D; fine in history)

name: net_import_lag48
meaning: net_import two days earlier

name: in_core
meaning: zone belongs to the Core flow-based region

name: n_presolved
meaning: Core-wide count of presolved constraints (same for every Core zone)

name: min_ram_ratio
meaning: Core-wide minimum RAM/Fmax (same for every Core zone)

name: jao_n_exposed
meaning: number of presolved constraints with |zone-to-rest PTDF| >= 0.05 (PTDF_z - mean of the other Core hubs; slack-invariant)

name: jao_min_ram_exposed
meaning: smallest RAM/Fmax among those constraints: how tight the zone's binding lines are

name: jao_tightness
meaning: PTDF-weighted mean scarcity: sum |zone-to-rest PTDF| (1 - min(RAM/Fmax, 1)) / sum |zone-to-rest PTDF|, in [0, 1]; not a count

name: jao_amr_share_exposed
meaning: share of those constraints whose RAM was lifted by AMR (minimum-RAM policy)

name: jao_min_ram_grid_exposed
meaning: smallest (RAM - AMR)/Fmax among them: the tightest margin before the policy uplift

name: jao_tightness_grid
meaning: jao_tightness computed on (RAM - AMR)/Fmax: weighted mean scarcity without the uplift, in [0, 1]

name: jao_n_exposed_lag24
meaning: jao_n_exposed of the same hour on D-1 (day D-1's domain: safe)

name: jao_min_ram_exposed_lag24
meaning: jao_min_ram_exposed on D-1

name: jao_tightness_lag24
meaning: jao_tightness on D-1

name: jao_amr_share_exposed_lag24
meaning: jao_amr_share_exposed on D-1

name: jao_min_ram_grid_exposed_lag24
meaning: jao_min_ram_grid_exposed on D-1

name: jao_tightness_grid_lag24
meaning: jao_tightness_grid on D-1

name: flow_phys
meaning: ENTSO-E physical flow from_zone -> to_zone, MW

name: flow_phys_lag48
meaning: physical flow two days earlier

name: flow_phys_lag168
meaning: physical flow one week earlier

name: flow_sched
meaning: JAO day-ahead scheduled exchange (Core borders)

name: flow_sched_lag24
meaning: scheduled exchange on D-1

name: maxbex
meaning: JAO maximum bilateral exchange, MW (Core borders from 9 Jun 2022)

name: maxbex_lag24
meaning: maxbex on D-1 (safe)

name: net_flow_lag48
meaning: flow_phys_lag48(a->b) - flow_phys_lag48(b->a): net direction

name: util_lag48
meaning: flow_phys_lag48 / maxbex_lag24 where both exist: how congested the border was

name: is_core_border
meaning: both ends are Core zones

name: constraint_id
meaning: stable id: sha1(CneEic | Direction | ContName)[:12]; one line under one contingency

name: ram
meaning: remaining available margin, MW

name: fmax
meaning: maximum admissible flow, MW

name: ram_fmax
meaning: RAM / Fmax: 0 = no headroom, 1 = full line available; > 1 from counter-flows (fltn < 0), not policy

name: frm
meaning: flow reliability margin, MW

name: f0core
meaning: flow with zero Core net positions, MW (loop / transit flow)

name: fltn
meaning: flow including long-term nominations (FtotalLtn = f0core + LTN flow), MW; RAM = fmax - frm - fltn + amr - iva

name: amr
meaning: adjustment for minimum RAM, MW: margin added by the 70 % (or derogation) policy

name: iva
meaning: individual validation adjustment by the TSO, MW (reduces RAM)

name: min_ram_factor
meaning: minimum-RAM target as a fraction of Fmax (0.7 under the CEP; lower with derogations)

name: ram_grid_fmax
meaning: (ram - amr) / fmax: margin the grid model leaves before the policy uplift (can be < 0)

name: amr_fmax
meaning: amr / fmax: size of the policy uplift

name: ptdf_<zone>
meaning: published zone-to-slack PTDF of the 12 Core zones (DE -> DE_LU); only differences are physical: use constraints.rest_ptdf / zone_ptdf
